The FloPlast Hi-Cap uPVC 115mm half round union bracket in black, is a crucial component for connecting 2 lengths of high capacity guttering systems. Its semi-elliptical design ensures a high capacity flow, which can effectively reduce the number of outlets and drainage runs required for efficient rainwater management. This robust uPVC gutter bracket is ideal for a wide range of building projects, including new build homes, property refurbishments, conservatories, and extensions, providing reliable and durable guttering solutions. Installation is straightforward, requiring 2 x 25 x 5mm screws to secure it firmly to the fascia board, ensuring a secure and long-lasting connection for FloPlast gutter systems.
